phrases: do more harm than good
表示某事弊大于利
We regard them as unnecessary creatures that do more harm than good.
我们认为它们是无用的生物，弊大于利。
wage war on
对...发动战争/发起攻势
We continually wage war on them, for they contaminate our food.
我们不断地对它们发动战争，因为它们污染我们的食物。
without provocation
无缘无故地，无端地
They sting or bite without provocation.
它们无缘无故地蜇人或咬人。
be filled with revulsion
充满厌恶感
Knowing that the industrious ant lives in a highly organized society does nothing to prevent us from being filled with revulsion.
尽管知道勤劳的蚂蚁生活在高度组织化的社会中，这并不能阻止我们对它们产生厌恶感。
stand in awe
敬畏地站着，肃然起敬
Who has not stood in awe at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly?
看到蜘蛛扑向苍蝇时，谁没有敬畏地驻足观看？
pounce on
猛扑，突然袭击
Who has not stood in awe at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly?
看到蜘蛛扑向苍蝇时，谁没有敬畏地驻足观看？
embark on
开始从事，着手进行
I immediately embarked on an experiment.
我立刻着手进行一项实验。
give up in despair
绝望地放弃
I got up early next morning hoping to find that the ants had given up in despair.
第二天一大早我起床，希望发现蚂蚁已经绝望地放弃了。
discover a new route
发现新的路线
Instead, I saw that they had discovered a new route.
然而，我发现它们已经找到了一条新的路线。
find an answer to
找到...的答案/解决办法
The ants had been quick to find an answer to my thoroughly unscientific methods!
蚂蚁很快就找到了对付我完全不科学的方法的答案！

grammar.k: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous)
grammar.d: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在并且可能继续下去的动作，常与all morning/afternoon, for hours, since等时间状语连用 强调动作的持续性、反复性或持续产生的结果
ex: We have been brought up to fear insects.
我们从小就被教育要害怕昆虫。
I have been learning English for five years.

grammar.f: even though / even if / although / though + 从句；no matter how + 从句
grammar.d: 表示虽然存在某种情况，但主句的动作或状态仍然成立 用于表达转折关系，强调尽管存在困难或相反情况
ex: No matter how much we like honey, or how much we have read about the uncanny sense of direction which bees possess, we have a horror of being stung.
无论我们多么喜欢蜂蜜，或者我们读过多少关于蜜蜂具有不可思议的方向感的文章，我们仍然害怕被蜇。
Even though it failed to get rid of the ants, it kept me fascinated.
虽然它没能消灭蚂蚁，但它让我着迷了24个小时。

grammar.f: Who/What + has not + 动词...?(谁能不...呢?)
grammar.d: 用否定形式提问，但期望得到肯定回答，表示强调 用于反问，强调说话人认为大家都会有某种感受或行为
ex: Who has not stood in awe at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly?
看到蜘蛛扑向苍蝇时，谁没有敬畏地驻足观看？
Who has not experienced this feeling?
谁没有体验过这种感觉呢？

patterns.p: No matter how + much/how/形容词..., + 主句
o: No matter how much we like honey, or how much we have read about the uncanny sense of direction which bees possess, we have a horror of being stung.
无论我们多么喜欢蜂蜜，或者我们读过多少关于蜜蜂不可思议的方向感的文章，我们仍然害怕被蜇。
im: No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't solve the problem.
无论我多么努力，我都无法解决这个问题。
No matter how expensive the phone is, people will buy it.
无论手机多贵，人们都会买。

patterns.p: We have been + 过去分词 + to + 动词原形
o: We have been brought up to fear insects.
我们从小就被教育要害怕昆虫。
im: We have been taught to respect the elderly.
我们从小就被教导要尊重老人。
Children have been encouraged to read more books.
孩子们一直被鼓励多读书。

patterns.p: Who has not + 过去分词 + at the sight of...?
o: Who has not stood in awe at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly?
看到蜘蛛扑向苍蝇时，谁没有敬畏地驻足观看？
im: Who has not felt surprised at the news?
听到这个消息时，谁没有感到惊讶？
Who has not experienced loneliness in a foreign country?
在异国他乡时，谁没有经历过孤独？

o: I am especially proud of it, not only because it has survived several severe winters, but because it occasionally produces luscious peaches.
我特别为它感到骄傲，不仅因为它度过了几个严冬，而且因为它偶尔会结出甘美的桃子。
im: I love this city, not only because it has beautiful scenery, but because the people are friendly.
我爱这座城市，不仅因为它有美丽的风景，而且因为人们很友好。
She is a good teacher, not only because she is patient, but because she is passionate.
她是一位好老师，不仅因为她有耐心，而且因为她充满热情。
